scope.selection: Current local BSC/SOL research candidates, not user-specified tokens
scope.sample: 50 profit-ranked trader rows per token; not a complete holder census

independentlyVerified.notes: Publicnode transaction+block succeeded; receipt required another public RPC because Publicnode returned archive-token requirement.

limitations: Coordination is not proof of common control, project control, manipulation, or identity.
Profit-ranked selection has survivorship bias; no full wallet history/holder distribution scan was performed.
Common exchange/router funding is not an ownership edge.
GMGN start_holding_at is not necessarily the first historical buy; current snapshots are not evidence available at past entries.
Live CLI uses tx_hash/event_type and native_transfer.from_address; initial projected missing fields were re-queried using observed schema.
Activity CLI returned 20 rows for most requests despite limit=100; displayed pages reach before the sampled token creation but are not whole-wallet histories.
Explorer web pages could not be retrieved; key public-chain facts were verified through RPC instead.
No strategy changes, watchlist additions, ledger changes, signed requests, broadcasts, restarts, or TG/Square messages.
